Fit against the calibration targets

Provenance

This report is qmd/reports/arms/arm-baseline.qmd, rendered once per arm by R/render_arm_reports.R. It reads only cached baselines under output/scenarios/arms/<arm>/runs/baseline.RDS and runs no model.

The nine blocks are taken from ../LEEDS/policyreport 2/policy-report-aug13.Rmd. The two differences from that original: the two series are two arms rather than a baseline and a shock, so there is no shock line; and every block is drawn in levels, because the two arms start from different initial states and an index to each arm’s own t = 2 value compares those starting points rather than the paths.
